capabilities: Create mindmap boards saved as .board.md Markdown files
Mark nodes with task statuses and roll progress up to parents
Set due dates with overdue highlighting and a due-soon filter
Link nodes to notes, web URLs and tags with hover previews
Export boards as a Markdown checklist, PNG, SVG or standalone HTML
disambiguation: Not a plain mindmap drawing tool; every node can carry a task status, due date, note link or tag.
extras: Desktop only and requires Obsidian 1.13 or later; releases are built by GitHub Actions with build provenance attestations; the store listing notes it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; no hotkeys are preset, all actions are commands; MIT licensed.
motivation: The author wanted a single tool that combines freeform mindmapping with task progress, since Canvas lacks progress tracking and task lists lack sketching space.
problem: Obsidian's Canvas offers freeform thinking space but tracks no task progress, while task lists have structure but no room to sketch spatially.

relations.evidence: Canvas gives you space to think but knows nothing about progress

summary: Freeform mindmap board where nodes can be tasks with statuses and due dates, saved as a readable Markdown note in the vault.
